annotation.title_clean: 遠隔操作型小型車の遠隔操作を行う者に対する指示の基準等について（通達）
annotation.title_en: Notice on Standards for Instructions to Persons Remotely Operating Remotely-Operated Small Vehicles
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 警察庁交通局交通企画課 (National Police Agency, Traffic Planning Division)
named_instruments_referenced: Japan Road Traffic Act (Act No. 32 of 2022 amendment)
annotation.summary_en: Japan National Police Agency circular (1 March 2023) to prefectural police setting standards for instructing remote operators and users of remotely-operated small vehicles (delivery robots) under the amended Road Traffic Act, including procedures, reporting demands, on-site inspections, and tables of violations with example instructions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Police may instruct remote operators violating traffic rules on how to travel, in person, by phone or via vehicle device.
Public safety commissions may instruct users, including suspending remote operation, after a hearing/explanation opportunity.
Commissions may demand reports and conduct on-site inspections of remote equipment, personnel, logs and location history.
Instructions must be proportionate, specific and related to the violation, e.g. operator retraining or equipment repair.
Tables list violation scenarios (pedestrian yielding, emergency stop access, vehicle marking, notification breaches) with example instructions.
